hints.title: Leftmost Sufficient Capacity
hints.text: We need to quickly locate the first index j where basket capacity is at least the current fruit requirement.

hints.title: Range Maximum Representation
hints.text: Represent basket capacities in a range maximum segment tree so child subtrees can be queried for sufficient maximum value.

hints.title: Binary Descent on Tree
hints.text: Traverse down to the left child if its maximum capacity is sufficient, otherwise go right. Update the leaf to -1 upon placement.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: number of fruits and baskets
complexity.notes: Building tree takes O(n) and each of the n queries and point updates takes O(log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) linear searching times out when n reaches 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Segment tree stores range maximums allowing logarithmic leftmost search.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use range maximum segment tree with tree traversal to find the first valid element.
